loopkeeper.welcome.intro.title: LoopKeeper — close the loop you keep meaning to close
loopkeeper.welcome.intro.copy: Start with one person you keep meaning to contact. Set the rhythm. Close the loop.
loopkeeper.welcome.intro.surprise: Stay to the end — we’ll close one real loop together.
loopkeeper.welcome.card.title: The card is everything
loopkeeper.welcome.card.copy: Every person you keep meaning to reach is a card. Tap it — everything for that one person lives there. Start with the few who matter most; add more as you close the current.
loopkeeper.welcome.loopmotto.title: No more “I keep meaning to”
loopkeeper.welcome.loopmotto.copy: Every missed reply starts the same way: “I keep meaning to.” LoopKeeper catches that thought before it cools — it reads the deep context, surfaces the person you owe, and hands you the words while the moment is still warm. The loop closes before the fire goes cold.
loopkeeper.welcome.fourws.title: The deep context
loopkeeper.welcome.fourws.copy: Who, What, Where, When — the story behind every card. The best secretaries always knew it: knowing the background of relationships and transactions is what makes every follow-up, signal and draft land.
loopkeeper.welcome.followup.title: The follow-up engine
loopkeeper.welcome.followup.copy: It reads the deep context and schedules the check-ins you keep meaning to make, surfacing who you owe a reply — the small loops caught before they go cold.
loopkeeper.welcome.followup.emphasis: You no longer forget. You no longer delay. You no longer postpone.
loopkeeper.welcome.confidante.title: The AI drafts — you hit Send
loopkeeper.welcome.confidante.copy: The draft is written on this phone. A warmer version only leaves if you tap Try again — the address book does not go with it.
loopkeeper.welcome.storage.title: Telefoonkan
loopkeeper.welcome.storage.copy: Your cards live here. Cloud (your Dropbox, Drive, OneDrive) and our server stay off until you turn them on.
loopkeeper.welcome.pricing.title: Basic $1 · Assistant $5
loopkeeper.welcome.pricing.copy: Seven days free with the Assistant at full strength. Basic catches five loops a month — enough to clear what’s owed. Assistant catches them all. Billing lives in Settings.
loopkeeper.welcome.outro.title: That’s the tour — it’s all live
loopkeeper.welcome.outro.copy: You’re set. Pick your first person — we’ll start there. Replay this demo any time from Settings → Welcome Again.
loopkeeper.welcome.taste.title: Let’s close one real loop — right now
loopkeeper.welcome.taste.copy: Pick the person you keep meaning to text. We’ll work through that one together: compose the message, then you send.
loopkeeper.welcome.st.mottoCatch: The loop closes before the fire goes cold.

loopkeeper.welcome.meter.title: One sentence separates you from autopilot
loopkeeper.welcome.meter.copy: Without your captures, LoopKeeper is just another contacts app — the one your phone already has. The Loop-O-meter shows this honestly. Capture a single loop and the engine wakes: drafts, nudges, receipts — climbing from Contacts manager to Loop tracker, Loop closer, and finally Autopilot.

loopkeeper.aboutTxt.tagline: Dhammaadka 'Waxaan doonayaa, laakiin aan weli sameyn.'
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.privacyTitle: No account. The book stays here.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.privacy1: We never ask for an email or a number. Anything you add is voluntary and lives on this phone unless you turn Cloud or Server on.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.privacy2: We cannot message your people. Sending opens WhatsApp or the phone app. LoopKeeper is made by Zyppar — bookmark https://zyppar.com/loopkeeper/.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.what: LoopKeeper waa kaaliyaha xiriirrada la socda — daawaha 'Waxaan doonayaa, laakiin aan weli sameyn.' Dooro qof keliya oo kugu muhiim ah, gelii heer — cunto bil kasta, wicitaan waqti-mar hore — markii wakhtigu imaado, LoopKeeper wuu ku xasuusinayaa, wuu kaa caawinayaa inaad xiriirka dhammaystirto, calaamadahuna way muuqdaan si daacadnimo aad aragto. Qof keliya waqti kasta, ma aha buugga teleefoanka oo dhan: guul yar oo dhammaystiran, ka dibna tan xigta. Fikradda xududda ah waa mid ka duwan barnaamij kasta — giraanta soo rogo ilaa 1958.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.hist1: Dhallinyarada maanta waxay lumi karaan sida aad u muhiim u ahayd in xafiisiye qaali ah uu kaydiyo diiwaanada — xiriirrada, xiriirrada shaqsiyeed, taariikhaha, ballanta — madaxa ugu fiican. Waxba lama illoobo, wax walba si nadiif ah ayay u socotay, weligeed.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.hist2: Ka hor barnaamijyada, xusuusu wuxuu ku noolaa miis. Rolodex — tusaha duulinta ee Arnold Neustadter, oo 1956 la oggolaaday, 1958 miisas kasta saarnaaday — wuxuu dul fadhiistay teleefoanka xafiis kasta oo khibrad leh. Kaar keliya qof kasta: magac, number, farriin qalin la qoray — subaxnimo ayuu jeclaa, ka weydii gabadhiisa. Giraanta rogo, raadi wajiga, wac teleefoanka. Kaartu waxay siday faahfaahinta si qofka miiska taagan uu siday xiriirka.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.hist3: Waxaa xigay galalmaha jeedhadaha plastig oo meelaha kaarada — magaca Rolodex wuu ka badbaaday dhammaadka tiro la'aan ah. Bilowgii wuxuu ahaa miiska xafiiska qarsoodiga, xarunta deeqsiga ah ee xafiiska madaxa. Kadib wuu yaraaday oo fududaaday, oo ganacsatadu mid ama dhowr ayay lahaayeen — ama midkooda ayay la wadaageen xafiisiyahooda.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.hist4: LoopKeeper waa fikraddaas, weli shaqaynaysa: kaar keliya qof kasta, oo siday sheekadiisa. Waxa cusub waa kaartu jawaab celin — markasta oo la diro, Kaaliyuhu wuxuu ku qoraa waxa dhacay, si xasuusta xigta u imaado oo horeba og. Rolodex jawaab celin leh. Adigay daacadnimo bixisaa; kaartu waxay xusuus ku tahay.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.timelineTitle: Miiska ilaa xiriirka — shan xilli oo la socdo
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.era1: Miis kastaa wuxuu lahaa kaydi yar.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.era2: Rogo, raadi, wac — kaar keliya qof kasta.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.era3: Magacu wuu ka badbaaday; giraantii miiska ka baxday.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.era5: Kaartu way jawaabaysaa — AI waa xafiisiga cusub.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.eraClose: Giraantii waa noqotay xiriir. Kaartu way qorantaa. LoopKeeper waa xafiisiyaas, dijitaal ah.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.why: Qof kastaa oo dhan wuxuu sidaa deyn qarsoodi ah: saaxiib aad rabto inaad wacdo, mahadnaq qorista ku dhintay, dhalasho seegtay oo aad rabtay inaad xasuusato. Qofna ma joojin jacayl — noloshu way qaylisay, iyo meel u dhexeysa rabitaanka iyo falka, dabkuu dhintay. Wax aan dhammaystirn wuu naqsan yahay maska ilaa uu dhammaado; saynisku wuu ogyahay tan iyo Zeigarnik, 1927. LoopKeeper wuxuu jiraa si uu u dhammaystiro kuwa yaryar ka hor intaysan qiimo gelin: heer hal mar la dejiyo, xasuus markii ay timaado, fariin diyaar ah marka aad u heshid laba daqiiqo oo bannaan. Ballanta ay bixiso waa fudud — dadka aad rabto inaad hayso way ku maqleysanayaan marka ay weli qiimo leedahay.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.pillSub: Noocyo toban oo dad ah oo lumiya lacag dhab ah ama jacayl dhab ah xiriirrada la dhammaystirin
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.cohortsIntro: Mid kastaa wax ayaa isaga lumaysaa toddobaad kasta xiriirrada furan — fattuurad, kalsooni, meel xusuus qof. Naftaada hel, LoopKeeper toddobaadkaada loo diyaariyay. Qof aad jeceshahay hel, waa dirid keliya.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c1: Shaqeeyaayaasha madaxbannaan iyo la-taliyayaasha — xiriirku waa ganacsiga; xasuus-dhacyadu waa fattuurad lumaysa
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c2: Milkiilayaasha ganacsiyada yaryar iyo shaqsiga keliya shaqeeya — macaamiil, badeecad-radinta, la-taliyayaal aamusay
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c3: Iibiyayaasha iyo horumarinta ganacsiga — 'xilli xigta ayaanu ku noqoneynaa' waa xiriir furan si cad
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c4: Raadiyayaasha shaqada iyo la-taliyayaasha — musharaxiintu way sugayaan jawaabo la seegay
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c5: Hogaamiyayaasha bulshada iyo diinta — ballan-qaadyo yar yar oo toddobaad kasta ah ('aan ku waco toddobaadkan')
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c6: Ururada NGO iyo abaabulayaasha mutadawaciinta — taageerayaashu iyo mutadawaciintu way sugayaan hadal
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c7: Saxaafadda iyo warbaahinta — ilo iyo soo-jeedmo aan qabowsan
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c8: Wakiilada guryaha — macaamiil bilaha luqdaa, markale diyaar u iibsiga
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c9: Qoysaska qurbajoogta — ina-adeer, waalidiin, 'aan sheekaysano' wakhtiyada kala duwan
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.c10: Koochada, barayaasha iyo abaabulayaasha dhacdooyinka — shabakado ku salaysan ballanqaadyo hal-xarig ah
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.cohortsShare: Naftaada halkan ka hel? Ku bilow xiriir hal ka mid ah oo aad dhab ahaanti ku qabto. Saaxiib, walaal, ama shaqaale kugu dhex muuqda tobankaas? LoopKeeper siiso — Settings → Share LoopKeeper.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.plan1: LoopKeeper (Basic · $1/bil): kaarada dadka muhiimsan, kooxaha, xasuusinayaasha, mashiinka xiriirka, dhalashooyinka, is-waafajinta, pods, wadahadal app-ka gudihiisa.
loopkeeper.aboutTxt.plan2: LoopKeeper (Assistant · $5/bil): wax kasta oo Basic ah, iyo Kaaliyaha — fariimaha lagu sameeyo codkaada, kor la akhriyo ka hor intaadan dirin, iyo hagayaal, soo jeedmo xiriir iyo waqti.

loopkeeper.walk.mineSub: A sample name — one tap brings someone real from your phone. They stay on it.
loopkeeper.add.title: Ku dar qof
loopkeeper.add.msg: They stay on this phone. We never message them. Pick one person, or several.
loopkeeper.add.pickToast: Ka soo qaadista telefoonka waxay u baahan tahay Android Chrome — ama si gacanta ah ugu dar qofka.
loopkeeper.share.voiceD: Isdiiwaangelin majirto — telefoonkaaga ayay ku nooshahay. Jawaabta aad rabto inaad dirto, la qoray, adigu riix Dir: {{url}}
loopkeeper.privacy.madeBy: LoopKeeper waxaa sameeyay Zyppar. Calaamadee https://zyppar.com/loopkeeper/.
loopkeeper.privacy.analyticsBody: Launches, sessions, sends, closes — never contacts, names, or message text. Off if you toggle it.
loopkeeper.welcome.privacySlideTitle: Akaun majirto. Buugga halkan ayuu joogaa.
loopkeeper.welcome.privacySlideCopy: We never ask for an email or a number. People you add live on this phone. Sending happens in WhatsApp or the phone app — not through us.
loopkeeper.welcome.privacySlideEmphasis: Iimeel majirto. Lambar majirto. Dadkaaga kuma diri karno.
loopkeeper.welcome.st.stayOptional: optional — off until you say so
loopkeeper.add.prefaceBody: Hal qof ama dhowr. Telefoonkan ayay ku hadhaan. Koobi ma qaadno, mana u dirno fariin.
loopkeeper.add.stayToast: {{n}} on this phone. None sent anywhere.
loopkeeper.walk.weDontSend: Tani waxay furaysaa WhatsApp ama telefoonka. Annagu ma dirno.
loopkeeper.welcome.confidante.emphasis: Ereyada way diyaar yihiin. Adigu riix Dir.
loopkeeper.welcome.taste.surprise: Hal diritaan dhab ah. Telefoonka ayay ku hadhaan.
loopkeeper.welcome.card.emphasis: Hal qof. Hal kaadh. Wax kasta oo isaga ah halkaas ayay ku nool yihiin.
loopkeeper.add.iosBody: Apple uma oggola barnaamij internet oo akhriyo xiriiriyeyaasha telefoonka — LoopKeeper midna, waan ka xunnahay. Telefoonkaadu waa sax. Laba si oo daacada ah: halkan ku qor (ilbiriqsiyo qof kasta), ama sug barnaamijka LoopKeeper ee App Store, wuu si fiican u akhriyi doonaa.
loopkeeper.loopkeeper.add.vcfFail: Faylkaasi kuma jiro xiriiriye aan akhriyi karno.
loopkeeper.add.vcfHint: Waxa akhriya fayl xiriiriyeyaal (.vcf) aad horeba dhoofiyay - laga soo dejiyay Google Contacts, iCloud internetka, ama telefoonkaga hore.
loopkeeper.add.iosOnestep: Iyadoo la sugto barnaamijka LoopKeeper ee iPhone, qof keliya waqti kasta waa ka fiican: ku qor marka aad u baahato.
loopkeeper.add.vcfHow: Ama keen hal mar oo dhan:
loopkeeper.add.vcfStep1: Ka soo saar xiriiriyeyaashaaga fayl .vcf - laga bilaabo Google Contacts ama iCloud internetka.
loopkeeper.add.vcfStep3: Guji albabka soo dejinta hoose, ka dibna dooro faylka.
loopkeeper.add.sysNote: Haddii telefoonkuu markaas muujo ogeysi sheegaya xiriiriyeyaasha "la wadaagi doono zyppar.com" - taasi waa hadalka caadiga ah ee telefoonka wax kasta oo akhriya xiriiriyeyaal. Dadka aad doorato waxay ku dhammaadaan LoopKeeper telefoonkan; naga waxba kama helno.
